title: Frontend e2e test suite — non-blocking review follow-ups
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #103 (frontend-e2e-tests), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so they aren't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: README.md's new 'End-to-end tests' section (added by PR #103) replaced the previous '## MCP servers' heading but never restored a heading for the paragraph that used to sit under it ('MCP server configuration lives in .mcp.json ...') — that paragraph is now headless, directly under the new e2e section's content with no '## MCP servers' heading above it, plus a doubled blank line was left behind. Add back a '## MCP servers' heading immediately before that paragraph and clean up the extra blank line.

backend/app/data/fixture_provider.py's get_weekly_ohlcv (line 88) recomputes the full synthetic daily series from scratch via its own independent call to _series(ticker) instead of resampling the frame get_daily_ohlcv already builds. Not a correctness issue (both calls are seeded identically so results are always consistent), just wasted work -- any request needing both daily and weekly data for the same ticker (e.g. the stock-analysis page, which the e2e suite hits directly) runs the same ~420-iteration RNG loop twice. Simplify get_weekly_ohlcv to resample self.get_daily_ohlcv(ticker)'s own output instead of calling self._series(ticker) a second time.

frontend/playwright.config.ts is not included in either tsconfig.app.json's or tsconfig.node.json's `include` array, so `npx tsc -b --noEmit` (and therefore `npm run build`) never type-checks it -- Playwright only validates it at its own runtime when `npm run test:e2e` is actually invoked. Add it to tsconfig.node.json's `include` (it's a Node-context config file, matching vite.config.ts's placement) so a type error in it surfaces at build/lint time rather than only when someone happens to run the e2e suite.
